collection.description: A child asks why a beloved elder will not return.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why a beloved elder will not return.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a caregiver, explains gently that the body stopped working and cannot come back.

a2.text: (child) asks whether everyone dies, and (adult) answers honestly without frightening detail.
